description: Source code for a class that manages flashing operations with nrfjprog tool, including command execution, error handling, and device management.

classes.name: NrfJprogBinaryRunner
classes.description: A class that provides an interface to run nrfjprog commands for flashing Nordic Semiconductor devices.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this runner, 'nrfjprog'.

methods.name: tool_opt_help
methods.description: Provides help text for additional nrfjprog options.

methods.name: do_create
methods.description: Creates an instance of NrfJprogBinaryRunner with configuration and arguments.

methods.name: do_get_boards
methods.description: Retrieves list of device serial numbers via 'nrfjprog --ids'.

methods.name: do_exec_op
methods.description: Executes a specified operation (e.g., program, reset, erase) on the device using nrfjprog.
